title: All Options Considered: Is 100 Too High for Rates Volatility?
summary: US rates volatility is elevated relative to the lows of early 2026, but remains around longer-run historical norms and higher forward rates may limit how far it can retrace. In this edition of All Options Considered, BI Chief Global Derivatives Strategist Tanvir Sandhu examines what a reading of 100 means in historical context, where volatility is concentrated across the swaption surface and why the risks priced by the options market are becoming more two-sided.

title: UK Budget Lacked 'Big Picture Themes,' RBC Capital Says

title: Healey Raises UK Banks Tax, Vows to Keep Finances Stable
summary: Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey pledged fiscal discipline in the face of harsh global economic conditions as he delivered the first budget of Andy Burnham’s new Labour administration. His measures included a plan to impose an additional 3% tax on banks, increasing the existing surcharge to 6%. Bloomberg's Caroline Hepker reports from Westminster. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Investors Jolted by Lula Win Search for Bottom After Brazil Rout

title: GE Vernova to Pay $9 Billion for Grid Supplier Trench Group

title: World Bank Raises Commodity Price Outlook Citing War and El Niño

title: Ethiopia Takes Delivery of Russia Fighter Jets Ahead of Schedule

title: Former Fed President Harker Says Policy Is Not Restrictive
summary: Former Philadelphia Federal Reserve President Patrick Harker expects the Fed to hold steady on interest rates Wednesday, saying, “I don’t think that’s the correct decision in my mind, but that’s what you’re gonna get.” Harker says the central bank will have to signal that more tightening is probably going to be warranted. (Source: Bloomberg)
